query:
UPDATE remote_history_states SET
               state = $2, retry_at = $3, last_error_class = $4,
               automatic_retry_at = CASE
                   WHEN $5 THEN $6
                   WHEN NOT $7 THEN $8
                   ELSE automatic_retry_at
               END,
               updated_at = now()
           WHERE account_id = $1
